To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the number and function of MOG-reactive autoreactive T cell in secondary lymphoid tissues were inconsistent with clinical course of EAE.
the frequency of autoreactive cells is not consistent with their function in the course of EAM mouse model.
the frequencies of MOG-specific T cells in secondary organs were not consistent with their function in the course of EAU.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dynamic changes in the frequency and function of autologous CD4+ and/or CD8+ T cell in EAE model.
the relationship between the number and function of MOG-reactive cells and the pathological changes of CNS in EAE course.
the dynamic changes of autoreactive cells and their functions in EAE course and provides new insights into the pathogenesis of EAE and MS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the frequency of T cells in the secondary lymphoid organs was not consistent with their function in the course of EAA.
the frequencies of MOG-reactive autoreactive CD8+ T cell in spleen and lymph node are not correlated with the pathological changes of CNS during the whole course of EAE.

the frequency of MOG-reactive lymphocyte in secondary lymphoid organ is not necessarily correlated with its function, and the function of MOG-reactivity is not necessarily correlated to the severity of EAE.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the frequency and function of myelin-reactive T cells are not necessarily correlated, and the dynamic changes in the frequency of myelin-reactivie T cells are not a good indicator for the clinical course of EAE.
the frequency of T cells was not always consistent with their functional activity, and this inconsistency might be one of the mechanisms for the pathogenesis of EAE.
the number of MOG-reactive lymphocytes was not consistent with their function in the course of EAU.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the frequency of autoreactive cells does not necessarily correlate with their function, which is an important factor for the pathogenesis of EAE.

the number and the function of autoregulatory T cells in secondary organs do not necessarily match in the course of EAA, and the dynamic changes of autoreactive IFN-γ+ CD4+ T cell and IL-17+ CD4+T cell in secondary lymphoid tissues are more consistent with the clinical severity of the disease.

the number and function of T cell subsets may change differently in EAE course and the function of autoregative T cells may be a better predictor than the number in evaluating the pathological severity of EAE.
